commands.OBJMASK: Creates wipeout objects behind selected text, MText, tables, or polylines to mask the background.
commands.VPFROMREG: Creates a viewport from a selected modelspace region using selectable paperspace layouts plus preset or custom architectural scales.
commands.LAYRED: Sets selected layer, region entities, or XREF-related layers to red based on the chosen mode.
commands.LAYGREEN: Sets all layers belonging to a selected XREF and its nested XREFs to green.
commands.AREALABEL: Reviews selected open or closed polylines in a room-naming window with drawing highlights, exports grouped room totals to AreaLabel.json, and stores invisible room names, areas, and base-point-relative locations directly on polylines for RC.
commands.CHECKLIST: Opens the project checklist window to guide drafting/design actions, with shared progress state saved to the drawing's project folder.
commands.PROJECTCHECKLIST: Opens the project checklist window with shared completion state for the drawing's folder.
commands.SETPANELLOCATION: Stores a panel location in the current drawing for electrical drafting commands.
commands.SETSCALE: Stores the current drawing scale for newly created electrical symbols and annotations.
commands.SETPANELNAME: Stores the panel name used by electrical drafting commands.
commands.SETPANELSCHEDULE: Links the current panel to an Excel panel-schedule workbook, configures circuit capacity, reserves the final six circuits as spares, and hides circuits above capacity.
commands.HOMERUN: Creates a scaled three-vertex Leader and panel-name MText using an interactive four-point workflow.
commands.DRAFTPALETTE: Opens the Electrical Drafting palette, which also opens by itself when AutoCAD starts (the checkbox at the bottom turns that off). It holds the drawing settings (panel name, scale, location, panel schedule, RC maximum load, home-run layer) and every drafting command, grouped, searchable by name or purpose, with an info icon that explains each one. Registered commands the palette does not describe yet appear under Other Commands.
commands.HRSETTINGS: Alias for DRAFTPALETTE (the palette was previously the Home Run Settings palette).
commands.R90: Rotates selected objects 90 degrees around a specified base point.
commands.R180: Rotates selected objects 180 degrees around a specified base point.
commands.R270: Rotates selected objects 270 degrees around a specified base point.
commands.R360: Rotates selected objects 360 degrees around a specified base point.
commands.R: Repeatedly places scaled RECEPT/Receptacles blocks and lets the user press S to choose from the block's available receptacle visibility states.
commands.RC: Circuits selected receptacles, automatically groups multi-receptacle selections by saved AREALABEL room boundaries, and updates the linked panel schedule.
commands.JBOX: Inserts a scaled junction box symbol: plain, with a switch, or wall-mounted, with the switch or wall mount placed on the north, east, south, or west side.
commands.DISCONNECT: Inserts a scaled disconnect symbol with its handle facing north, east, south, or west.
commands.SWITCH: Inserts a scaled cyan switch symbol at the picked location: standard ($), dimmer ($D), or occupancy sensor ($OS), chosen with prompt keywords.
commands.DATA: Inserts a scaled cyan triangle data symbol with its point facing north, east, south, or west (south by default).
commands.RTCAPTURE: Captures a hand-drawn room as a named room template saved in the drawing: select each group of symbols, keyed notes, and leaders that are placed together, pick its base point and facing direction, then select the circuit label text (or pick receptacles per circuit) to record the circuit split.
commands.RTPLACE: Places a room template group by group with a live preview. Space/Enter rotates the group 90 degrees, Wall aligns it to two picked wall points, Angle types a rotation, Flip turns it around, Skip leaves a group out, Back redoes the previous group; then circuits the receptacles with the template's circuit split in the linked panel schedule.
commands.RTLIST: Lists the room templates saved in the drawing and optionally deletes one.
commands.SCALEDTEXT: Places MText sized for the drawing scale (4.5" at 1/4" = 1'-0") and lets the user pick the direction it runs: north, east, south, or west, always readable.
commands.OPENLAYERS: Freezes or thaws selected layers across selected DWGs that are open in the current AutoCAD session.
commands.KEYNOTETABLE: Creates compact invisible-border keyed-note tables, or renumbers a selected table sequentially from 1 while adding missing KEYED_NOTE symbols.
commands.KNL: Places a KEYED_NOTE symbol with an attached leader: pick the leader tip, then drag the note into place; the leader runs level out of the hexagon then turns to the tip and ends in an arrow or open circle, chosen with the Arrow/Circle prompt keywords.
commands.GENERALNOTETABLE: Converts MText general note columns or grouped DBText lines into an invisible-border numbered table with three-point boundary-controlled overflow.
commands.SW: Places configured switch assemblies with interactive prompt options to change orientation (N/E/S/W), switch type (Standard/Dimmer/Occupancy), custom subscript, or open setup.
commands.SWN: Places a configured Standard Switch oriented North.
commands.SWE: Places a configured Standard Switch oriented East.
commands.SWS: Places a configured Standard Switch oriented South.
commands.SWW: Places a configured Standard Switch oriented West.
commands.DSWN: Places a configured Dimmer Switch oriented North.
commands.DSWE: Places a configured Dimmer Switch oriented East.
commands.DSWS: Places a configured Dimmer Switch oriented South.
commands.DSWW: Places a configured Dimmer Switch oriented West.
commands.OSWN: Places a configured Occupancy Switch oriented North.
commands.OSWE: Places a configured Occupancy Switch oriented East.
commands.OSWS: Places a configured Occupancy Switch oriented South.
commands.OSWW: Places a configured Occupancy Switch oriented West.
commands.SWSETUP: Interactive setup wizard to sample switch blocks and text objects from the drawing, auto-derive orientations, and persist project-wide.
commands.SWGUI: Opens the WPF Switch Configuration Manager window.
